independent_acceptance: general-purpose sub-agent, local brief e-acceptance.md: items 1-5 PASS with a mutation check each, then two deltas (new-conversation race, conversation list scoping) PASS; no blocking issues. Non-blocking notes: non-status transport errors still use str(exc) (host only, no token path).
boundaries_recorded: Already-issued presigned original URLs keep working until they expire after withdrawal (observed 206; browser URLs ≤ 15 min, corpus source URLs 5 min). Crops are served with 'private, immutable' — a browser that already fetched one keeps its copy; the server re-checks before every read.
Revocation removes derived content: the copier's own Wiki and conversations built on a withdrawn source disappear from their lists without a note, and come back when the source is republished.
No session kill switch: a live member's JWT stays valid until its 7-day expiry; removal (401 membership_revoked) and role changes take effect on the next request. There is no disable-user API.
Role governs uploads, keys, Wiki writes and copies; ownership alone governs rename/publish/delete of one's own resource (a viewer could still rename theirs).

Gateway source downloads are not retried: corpus/control down while the gateway fetches the original → explicit parse failure; the user re-parses (same job reused). Gateway Redis loss is bounded by the 24 h result TTL [code reading, not exercised].
Re-submitting the same URL to /v1/parse after deleting its resource returns 404 document_not_found although the gateway accepted the job (external API path, not fixed).
Index lease 300 s: a crashed index is resumed only after the lease expires (≈5 min), by whichever entry claims first (restarted worker or API reconciler).
Rejected/expired/failed upload originals are not collected (contract: operational follow-up).
